No VR world, F11, ESC, GOAL, stage timer, renderer R29–R33, R26_SAFE, input, FFB, SkyGlow, DX11, frozen DXVK edits.

Keep valid full/partial/pivoted menu contain and existing already-contained quad ledger while proving gameplay/GOAL/+TIME negative invariants in C++ compile-time regression.
Preserve original native D3DX return and Win32 R84 game/host/package, domain and source-inspector exact-SHA validation and HMD UNTESTED.

Gameplay HUD, GOAL and +TIME native D3DX transforms do not acquire the menu-only affine; partial/pivot menu and VR disabled fallback retain original behavior.
